<img src="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/4H1Mzs/wbwriter/main/Assets/logo-mark-1024.png" width="72" align="right" alt="WBWriter">

### What's new

- **Web control from a phone (optional).** Turn on **Web control** in the setup window and open the address it shows on any phone or laptop on the same network. You can **clear the board** (tap twice to confirm) and **show the performer a message**. The message appears in yellow in the hatched area of the touchscreen and stays until you remove it, or disappears after 10 s, 30 s or 1 min. It's never sent to NDI® or HDMI. You can set a PIN, and the port is configurable.
- **Calmer touchscreen.** The hatching around the board, the board border, the status line and the corner logo are all darker, so attention stays on the board. The corner logo is now grey.

### Download

WBWriter 1.1.1 or later offers this update by itself at launch. Otherwise download **`WBWriter-1.3.0.dmg`** (macOS 13+, Apple Silicon and Intel, signed and notarized), open it and drag WBWriter into Applications.

Linux and Windows are coming soon.
